repair.attempt77_failure_addressed: the active control-plane version passed, then the route reader collapsed the first data-plane response into V207_DISPOSABLE_ROUTE_INVALID before the Python urllib probe
repair.route_response_envelope: route bodies are streamed into at most 4096 bytes and classified only by fixed failure, HTTP status class, expected-version state, content-type class, and body-size-or-shape class
repair.route_redaction_policy: response body, response headers, URL, query, capability material, raw status text, and exception strings are never persisted, logged, or returned
repair.route_shape_policy: non-JSON, invalid JSON, invalid object shape, missing code, invalid code, missing or non-JSON content type, invalid or mismatched content length, oversized body, and body-read failure are distinct bounded codes
repair.active_route_retry_policy: only before the first exact 403 V207_AUTHORITY_REJECTED response with the expected Worker version, allow the established structured 404 V207_ROUTE_DISABLED fingerprint with a distinct valid predecessor UUID, retry V207_DISPOSABLE_ROUTE_UNREACHABLE, or retry a bounded route-response diagnostic whose status class is S5XX and version state is VMATCHED
repair.active_route_nonretry_policy: after the first exact active match every exception or mismatch is terminal; before it, missing or malformed version, wrong version outside the exact structured disabled-predecessor allowance, and S2XX, S3XX, S4XX, or SOTHER response diagnostics are terminal
repair.active_route_proof: three consecutive 403 V207_AUTHORITY_REJECTED responses carrying the exact active control-plane version remain required
repair.propagation_bound: retry stays inside the existing maximum 30 reads, 60 seconds, and 2-second sleeps; a transient never counts as a match and the match streak remains zero before the first exact match
repair.python_diagnostic_envelope: the exact Python urllib subprocess remains capped at 4096 bytes, rejects stderr, requires failure exit code 2, exact Worker version, and exact status-paired allowlisted Worker or R2-stage codes
repair.pre_gpu_probe: the exact Python urllib PUT, FINALIZE, GET authority, byte readback, and deterministic DELETE sequence remains required before any RunPod mutation or GPU dispatch
repair.retry_exclusions: no upload retry, GPU retry, qualification retry, redispatch, fallback, or post-first-match route retry

stop_conditions: independent audit is not materialized with zero P0, P1, and P2 findings
any control source, image source, published image digest, image lineage, config, GPU, region, rate, volume, billing, capacity, disposable-name, or policy drift

the exact active route version is not proven by three consecutive exact fingerprints within 30 reads and 60 seconds

a pre-first-match route result is neither the structured 404 V207_ROUTE_DISABLED fingerprint with a distinct valid predecessor UUID, unreachable transport, nor an exact-version S5XX bounded response diagnostic
any route exception or mismatch occurs after the first exact active fingerprint
the exact Python urllib pre-GPU upload/finalize/readback/delete probe does not pass and clean up
any malformed, unrelated, permanent non-S5XX, cleanup, reconciliation, or cumulative-cap uncertainty
any shared staging Worker mutation, image republication, GPU fallback, anchor refresh, volume mutation, upload retry, GPU retry, qualification retry, redispatch, or V2-08 action
